## Set up

1)  R and RStudio

If you don't already have them, install R and RStudio. Open up RStudio where we'll do work.

2)  Install R packages used throughout

```{r, eval=FALSE}
options(repos = c(
  duckdb = "https://duckdb.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))
packages <- c(
  "duckdb","dplyr", "dbplyr", "gt", "here",  
  "omopgenerics",  "omock", "CodelistGenerator", 
  "CohortCharacteristics", "CohortConstructor",
  "visOmopResults", "PhenotypeR"
)
pak::pkg_install(packages, ask = FALSE)
```

3)  Download mock data

```{r, eval=FALSE}
omock::downloadMockDataset("delphi-100k")
```
